name: Better Hitbox
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: Neerajisafk
description:
Hitbox Enchanced by Mayank (afkz studios)

  Colored hitboxes for combat training and PvP

  Hitbox Enchanced replaces Minecraft's vanilla F3+B hitboxes with fully customizable, color-coded hitboxes to help you
  visualize entity hitboxes during combat.
roadmap: Minecraft's libraries and client API (0.2), Code next to data (0.3)
evidence: Not run: Java did not start.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers
